tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying thig gi kha skong phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub kyi dbang bskur bklag chog tu bkod pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zha
༄༅/ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying thig gi kha skong phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub kyi dbang bskur bklag chog tu bkod pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zha

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying thig gi kha skong phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub kyi dbang bskur bklag chog tu bkod pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka badz+ra kī la ya ye/ /rdo rje'i ye shes snang ba'i nyin byed la/ /dngos grub gzi brjid 'bar bas skal bzang gi /yid kyi pad+mo'i dpal bskyed ki lā ya/ /sgrub pa'i dpyid du 'char ba dge legs stsol/ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snyig thig gi bye brag phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub kyi dbang gi las 'grigs kyi bca' bshom ni/ gang du bya ba'i gzhi der gzhung mthun ras bris sam tshom bu bkod steng mañji la bum pa rgyan ldan bcud kyi sum gnyis bkang ba/ sku tsaka /sngags byang*/ rdor sems sku tsaka /dur khrod dpal chas/ rdo rje rtse dgu dang rtse lnga/ kha ṭ+wām̐/ me phung*/ phur pa ste phyag mtshan phyogs bsdus kyi tsaka li gsang thod/ rig tsaka /gdab phur/ lcags hom du liṅga/ g.yab dar/ me hom/ zor chas phyogs bsdus/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa/ sman raka gtor ma/ bka' srung gi mchod gtor/ dkar bgegs sogs 'du byas la/ dbang sgrub ni/ brgyud 'debs nas brtsams bdag mdun dbyer med kyi las gzhung bsrang la bzlas pa'i dbur dzab¿ khang dbye/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bzlas pa skabs phyed par bya/ bum bzlas spyi ltar byas la bsnyen sgrub las sngags cung zad bzla/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed bzlas 'od zhu bya/ bdag 'jug gam rig pa'i me tog dor/ bka' srung gsol mchod/ tshogs mchod lhag ma'i bar btang dbang dngos la/ slob ma sgo drung du khrus byas/ nang du 'khod pa na bgegs gtor btang*/ srung 'khor bsgoms rjes/ chos bshad lo rgyus kyi khyad par/ de yang gsang sngags snga 'gyur la rgyud dang sgrub sde'i shing rta gnyis su 'byed pa'i phyi ma dbang btsan du byas na/ ye shes dang 'jig rten so mtshams kyi sgrub tshul sde brgyad du bzhugs pa'i lnga pa/ phur pa phrin las sgrub pa ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rdo rje lhag pa'i lha'i skur bzheng pas byin rlabs myur zhing sgrubs thag nye/

dpal gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i phur pa'i mkhan po zhes paṇa grub rig 'dzin kun gyi thugs dam/ da lta'i bar dngos grub brnyes pa'i mtshan rtags rgyun ma chad pa 'di la/ snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las kyi shing rta chen po thams cad mkhyen gzigs pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa la phur pa bka' gter rgyud lung man ngag du ma'i bka' babs nye rgyud ngo mtshar can du ma bzhugs pa'i bye brag /bka' babs rin po che bdun gyis rgyal bstan gling bzhi'i khyon la dbang bsgyur ba'i bzhi pa dgongs pa'i gter kha/ rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying thig gi chos sde phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub kyi dbang gi cho gas smin par byed pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma dang dpal chen po gnyis su med pa la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor gtso: sangs rgyas kun gyis phrin las bdag: ye shes khro bo chen po yis: bdag cag smin par mdzad du gsol: lan gsum/ zab mo dbang gi sgo 'byed phyir mdo sngags lam gyi 'jug sgo skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba sems rnam pa gnyis bskyed pa'i phyir mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dpal chen po zhi khro rab 'byams skyabs yul rgya mtsho'i bskor ba'i spyan sngar bdag sogs mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad 'khod pas lus ngag yid gsum rtse gcig gus pas mi slob 'bras bu'i skyabs gnas kyi go 'phang mngon du ma gyur par skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ nam mkha'i mthas btugs pa'i sems can thams cad srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i spyi dpal chen po he ru ka rdo rje khros pa'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa dbang gi rgyud smin cing lam rim pa gnyis brten nas rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rdzogs smin sbyang ba mthar son par bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos badzod/

na moḥ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu la: mi phyed gus pas skyabs su mchi: srid pa phur bu'i dkyil 'khor du: khams gsum bsgral bar sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ rgyud rnam par dag cing tshogs ma bsags na dbang gi ye shes bskyed mi nus pas tshogs zhing chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par sad pa'i spyan sngar rang gzhan mkha' mnyam gyi yid can thams cad phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba dang mchod pa 'bul zhing bshags pa yi rangs sems bskyed lus 'bul bsngo ba ste yan lag brgyad pa'i tshig gi rjes su don dran pas rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam 'phrul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la/ /dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rab bgrang ba'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ lan gsum/ rgyud sdom pa dang mi ldan pa dang snang ba thams cad tha mal du zhen pa la dbang gi bcud mi chags pas 'gro kun srid zhi'i mtha' las sgrol ba'i sems bskyed kyi go chas so byang sngags kyi sdom pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa dbang po'i rim pa dang 'tshams par tshogs kyi zhing rab 'byams kyi spyan sngar bzung zhing srung bar bgyid snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag gyur cig /spyod pa rmad byung bsam yas pa/ /'gro la phan phyir bdag gis spyad/ /byang chub sems mchog dam pa dang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong na/

/rdo rje rgyal pos byin rlabs mdzod/ /de dag sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i chos kyis rgyud snod rung du bsgrubs nas dngos gzhi dbang gis smin par byed pa la byin rlabs kyi gzhi 'god pa ye shes pa dbab pa'i sngon 'gro rdo rje ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam tshig rdo rje'i chu nan lce la myang ba snying dbus su ye shes chen po'i ngo bor gnyis su med par sim te ye shes sems pa'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pas srung nyams kyi dpang po mdzad par mos shig /dam chu ster la/ ye shes rdo rje 'da' ka'i chu: snying la sim pas dam srung nas: sems dpa' mchog myur dngos grub ster: 'das na brlag par gdon mi za: sa ma ya i dan na ra kan: ye shes dbab pa dngos la/ sgo gsum gyi gnad gcun te dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob ma'i phung khams skye mched kyi chos thams cad mi dmigs stong par sbyangs/ rnam shes 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa bla ma dpal chen po'i zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud mkha' gsang nas thig le hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i rnam par phyir spros/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor dbang stegs pad nyi'i steng du babs pa yongs su gyur pa las phyi snod rnam par dag pa 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla bdud bzhi spyi chings su bsnol ba'i steng*/ bcud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i phyag rgyar sgrub pa'i phyir khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag ston gnam dwangs ba'i mdog can/ zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing*/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu dang rtse lnga/ g.yon gnyis me phung kha ṭ+wāṃ/ tha ma'i phyag gnyis kyi ri rab lta bu'i phur pa 'dril ba/ zhabs bzhi gyad chen po'i dor stabs kyi bsgrad pa sku la dpal dang dur khrod rol pa'i chas kyis brgyan pa'i yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo skya dril bu dung khrag 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/

sku las ye shes kyi me phung 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i klong na bzhugs pa'i snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du gsal ba/ rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i phyag rgyar sgrub pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dpal he ru ka dngos yin snyam pa'i gdung shugs kyis bskul bas mdun bskyed dang gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer mkha' khyab tu spros pas phyogs dus skyabs yul rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung yongs kyi rje btsan rdo rje phur pa dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku sngags phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa ltar byon nas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas/ lhag pa'i lha'i gsang ba mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par byin gyis brlab par mos mdzod/ hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: dz+nyā na a bai ya sha a a: zhes bzla zhing spos rol ḍā dril dang bcas pas dbab bo/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan par bya/ de nas dbang dngos la lnga las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs te rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang bas dbang bskur bar gyur/ rnam bum thogs la/ hūm̐: rin chen bum pa mtshan rdzogs nang : bde chen bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi gtams: rigs lnga 'dus pa'i dam rdzas 'dis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ye shrī hūm̐: zhes bum chu 'thor zhing khar sbyin/ de ltar bum pa bzang po las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis khrus byas shing 'thung bas lus kyi nang gang*/

phung khams skye mched gdod nas dag pa'i gdan gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mngon du byas/ dug lnga ye shes su gnas gyur/ chu lhag spyi bor 'khyil ba'i zeg ma rdo rje mi spyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs kyi bdag po lngas rgyas gdab par bsam/ de ltar phyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor la bsten te bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ dag bya lus rtsa yi sgrib pa sbyangs/ dag byed bskyed rim dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ bsgrub bya sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa dang bcas pa mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas/ grub 'bras lus sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin mngon du byas pa'o/ bum dbang dang rjes su 'brel ba sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs nus 'jug gi dbang las dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sku las lha sku gnyis pa spros/ slob ma'i dpral bar thim pas/ sku snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i de nyid mngon du byas par mos mdzod/ sku tsaka gtad la/ hūm̐: mthing nag e yi klong dkyil na: 'bar ba gar dgu'i gzi byin can: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bskur ba: snang stong phyag rgyar sad par shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: de ltar rdo rje sku yi byin rlabs thob pas snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ting 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa gsung gi byin brlab bya ba'i phyir thog mar bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa la/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'i thugs nyi zla'i gā'u'i dbus ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ la bsnyen sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng bar ma chad du byung*/ gtso bo'i zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i khar zhugs te snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim par mos la bsnyen sngags 'bru dgu pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bsnyen sngags 'bru dgu pa lan gsum bzla/

slar yang gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sgrub sngags byung ba zhal nas thon/ rang gi khar zhugs te snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim pa'i 'od zer gyis snang srid rdo rje phur pa'i zhing dang lha skur gyur pa mos la sgrub sngags 'bru bcu bzhi pa lan gsum rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes lan gsum/ slar yang thugs ka'i sngags 'khor las las sngags spu gri'i phreng ba byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i khar brgyud/ snying gar thim pa'i 'od zer ljang nag mtshon cha'i tshogs can spros pas bsgral bya thams cad mngon spyod drug gi phrin las rim pa mthar phyin par mos la rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ma rak+mo yak+mo kā la ru pa: snying rtsa la yam̐ yam̐: srog rtsa la yam̐ yam̐: snying la phril phril: srog la chum chum: tsit+ta srog la dung dung : snying khrag srog la shad shad: thum ril li: rtseg rtseg: 'ur 'ur: sh-ig shig: gul gul: myag myag: sod sod: dhā ti ma ma karma shrī gh+ram̐ karma ka ra ye mā ra se na pra mar+dha na ye swā hā: lan gsum bzla/ de nyid brten pa'i phyir sngags phreng mgrin par bzhag la/ āḥ rnam pa thams cad rdo rje'i sgra: rang byung gsang ba'i sngags su shar: dngos grub kun gyi bcud 'dzin pa: snying po lung gi dbang bskur ro: wā ka¿ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de ltar rdo rje gsung gi byin rlabs thob pas grags stong sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum la dbang ba yin no/ gsum pa thugs kyi byin rlabs bya ba'i phyir/ gtso ba'i thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' rgyangs kyis byon nas snying gar thim pas bde stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par mos shig /rdor sems kyi sku snying gar bzhag la/ hūm̐/ 'khor dang ldan pa srog gi gor: snying dbus ye shes sems dpa' che:

badz+ra sa twa tshon gang bas: bde ba chen po'i thugs dbang sbyin: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: des rdo rje thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pas lhan skyes bsam mi khyab pa'i chos kyi de kho na nyid mngon du byas/ bskyed rdzogs kyi ting 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /de dag gi dpal chen po dang gnyis su med pa'i zag med kyi yon tan la dbang 'byor ba'i brda rtags su dpal dang dur khrod drag po'i chas kyis mnga' gsol bar mos shig /dur khrod dpal chas brgyan tshul byas la/ hūm̐: stobs dang rnam thar brgyad la sogs: zag med yon tan legs mtshon pa: dregs pa bsgral ba'i longs spyod che: yongs su rdzogs pas dbang bskur ro: gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñca swā: rang don du 'phags pa'i spang rtogs rdzogs nas gzhan don tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyis phrin las la mnga' brnyes pa'i rtags su phyag mtshan rnams phyag tu gtad par mos shig /phyag mtshan rnams gtad de/ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i rdo rjes mtshan rtog 'joms: kha ṭ+wām̐ dug gsum dbyings su gcod: khyab brdal thugs rje'i me dpung dang : phrin las phur bu'i dbang bskur ro: karma a bhi ṣiñca āḥ

gnyis pa gsang dbang sbyin pa ni/ bla ma dpal he ru ka yab yum gsal ba'i snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor shes pas slob ma'i khar byin pa snying gi pad+mar zhugs pas ting 'dzin bde ba dang bcas pa rgyud la skyes par mos shig /thod pa'i bdud rtsi'i gsang rdzas byin la/ hūm̐: chos kun thabs shes mnyam par sbyor: bde chen bdud rtsi'i snying por bskyil: gnyis med rol pa'i sems sprin sbyin: lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs shog: gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca ma hā su kha ho: zhes bdud rtsi myang bas rtsa thams cad bdud rtsi'i gang*/ dug gsum gyi rnam rtog 'gag /bde ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam/ zhes kun rdzob byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten te/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur nas/ dag bya ngag las rlung gi dri ma sbyong*/ dag byed rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang*/ sgrub bya longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog /grub 'bras ngag gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin mngon du byas pa'o/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang sbyin pa la/ gtso bo'i yum las phyag rgya gzugs dang lang tsho'i rgyan pa spros te thar par bsten par mos shig /rig tsaka gtad la/ hūm̐: bde ba chen po nam mkha'i dkyil: pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru reg pa yis: mngon sum myang zhing rtogs pa'i dbang : phyag rgya'i dbang bskur khyod la sbyin: karma mu tra sa ma ya ho: zhes ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang 'du shes gsum dang lhan cig par rol pas rgyu 'bras kyi dga' bzhi ngo sprod par mos shig /zhes phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur nas/ dag bya ngag gi dri ma sbyang*/ dag byed pho nya'i myur lam bsten pa la dbang*/ sgrub bya chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag /grub 'bras yid thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin mngon du byas pa'o/ /bzhi pa tshig dbang sbyin pa la/

gsum pa'i skabs kyi lhan skyes dpe byas nas/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi phyag rgya chen po lhan skyes kyi de nyid la mnyam par zhog shig /slob dpon gyis dgongs pa gtad la/ hūm̐: mi gnas ye shes nam mkha'i dbyings: rdo rje rang byung 'od gsal che: rang la gdod nas 'du 'bral med: rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid do: dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣiñca āḥ des don dam byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor la bsten nas/ dag bya sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyang*/ dag byed ye shes kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ sgrub bya rdo rje gsum dbyer med du sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi sku'i nus pa sad par byas/ grub 'bras sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o/ sgrol dbang spro na/ bla slob gnyis ka bdud chas su zhugs la/ de dag gis stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang bzhis rdo rje phur pa'i grub mtha' chen mo bzhi las bskyed rim srid pa phur bu/ rdzogs rim byang sems phur bu/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur bus dbang gis rtogs pas bdag bsgral ba'i nus ldan du sgrub pas lta ba'i rdzong zin/ sgom pa'i 'phrang bsgral/ spyod pas snying rje chen po'i srog mkhar tshugs par byas nas/ thugs rje'i gzhan sgrol bas byang chub kyi spyod pa rdzogs pa'i phyir smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang sbyin pa la/ gdul dka' rmu rgod kyi gdul bya rjes su lhag par 'dzin pa byang chub sems dpa'i khyad chos yin pas spyan dmigs 'di ltar mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad phrin las phur pa rol pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor chen por gyur: oṃ karma kro dhā ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa:

sarba karma yak+ṣa bh+yo dzaḥ snod bcud khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa la thams cad dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i sngon gyi thugs dam chen po'i las la bzhengs nas dmag dpung go gsar byed pa bzhin mngon spyod las la rngams par gyur/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi zad rab 'jigs skur ston pa: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: gnyis pa gser skyems ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gser skyems zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha: khyad par phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gzu dang dpang mdzod mngon spyod las la bzhengs: dpal mgon ma ning phur srung bcu gnyis dang : dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras: bka' bran g.yog mngags gzhugs bcas pa rnams: gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes las: gzu dang dpang mdzod mngon spyod las la bzhengs: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: sems skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gzu dang dpang mdzod mngon spyod las la bzhengs: brub khungs bskyed pa ni/ e yaṃ raṃ yongs su gyur pa las drag po'i btson khang gting ring ba/ dug lnga'i rang gzugs 'byung ba lnga 'khrug cing phyi nang du gshin rje'i dmag tshogs mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ rgyob sod kyi sgra sgrogs pas 'jigs su rung ba/ de'i nang du dgra bgegs byad ma nyam thag pa'i lus can 'o dod lhang lhang 'bod pa zhig tu gyur/ bden stobs brjod pa ni/ g.yab dril bcas/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma

sogs nas/ khyad par du phrin las phur pa rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khong gar gnas gar bros kyang skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig /rtsa sngags dang*/ ma rak+mo sogs spu gri'i mthar/ nṛ tṛ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭa: a bai sha ya aḥ zhes 'gugs 'chings sdom myos lha dang phral/ gshed du dbab la/ bsgral ba dngos ni/ sgrol phur thogs la/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab: phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab: shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab: sa bdag chen po'i dus la bab: bdag nyid chen po'i dus la bab: bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab: mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab: sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas bzhin: mngon spyod phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing : dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams: khro bo chen po'i tshogs rnams kyis: gtogs shing grogs dang bral bar gyis: phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis: zungs shig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rings par khug la smar chug cig: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: mo ha gha ta ya gha ga nan badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho:

sarba bigh+nān badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐: hūm̐ ka ra a: zhes tshe khrus gnas gsum gyi dgongs pa dang ldan pas phur pa gdab spu gri'i sngags kyis ling ro gtub/ thun gyis brab la/ hūm̐: sgrol byed 'bar ba kī la ya: khams gsum sku gsung thugs su rdzogs: dug lnga bsgral ba'i las byas pas: nyams pa rtsad gcod dbang thob shog: ces slob ma la bsgral du bcug /ling ro bdud rtsi'i bran te/ hūm̐: bdud 'dul phur pa'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs 'byung po bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: bde chen rdo rje'i longs spyod chen por bzhes: dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod: sarba sha trūn bigh+nān ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes gtor ma bstab/ me hom sbar la/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ: me hom drag po'i thab khung ye shes bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i zhal du dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag bstabs pas las la rngams shing dgyes pas dbang bskur bas nyams pa rdo rje'i mes bsregs pa'i las mthar phyin par mos shig /me hom 'grims te/ hūm̐: e dbyings 'bar ba'i me hom du: rig pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: dgra bgegs sha rus khrag kun 'bul: bdud bgegs bsregs pa'i dbang thob shog: ag+ni dz+wa la a bhi ṣiñca aḥ me hom gyi ye shes pa dbyings su gshegs/ thal ba gru gsum e klong mnan te rdo rjes rgyas gdab pas sa la mnan pa'i phrin las kyi dbang thob par mos shig /mnan chas gtad la/ hūm̐: rdo rje 'bar ba'i ri rab kyis: mnan na lha yang brlag nus pa'i: drag shul las kyi dbang bskur bas: gdug pa mtha' dag tshar gcod shog: s+t+waṃ bha ya a bhi ṣiñca ho: khrag 'thung dmod pa'i mtshon chen drag po zor rdzas kyi dbang bskur bas myur 'gyogs rlung la 'phang bas nyams pa bsgral ba'i las kyi dbang thob par mos shig

/zor chas gtad la/ hūm̐: gdug pa zor gyi mtshon cha 'di: rngams brjid 'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul can: phung byed rdo rje'i mtshon chen po: nyams pa sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog: sarba sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog bzlog: mā ra ya rbad: 'grim zhing 'thar thal rdeb dang bcas gnod pa'i phyogs su 'phang bar bya'o/ /de dag gis dbang gi rim pa rnams legs par grub pas dbang gi ye shes skyes brtan gong 'phel du byed pa shis pa'i me tog 'thor bas mnga' gsol bar mos shig /oṃḥ dbyings kyi ngo bo chos sku rdo rje sems: rig pa rang snang badz+ra ku mā ra: dbyings rig zung 'jug rtsa brgyud bla ma yis: mchog thun dngos grub 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: ces brjod rjes dam tshig khas blang yon phul spyi ltar bya/ las byang gi lhag ma nas brtsams rjes rim mthar dbyung ngo*/ /bdud 'dul phrin las rdo rje'i mtshon/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog drag po rtsal/ /byin rlabs dbang gi las rim mchog /skal bzang kun dga'i btsas su shar/ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying thig gi kha skong yi dam phrin las phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub kyi dbang gsar spros le'u tshan dang po'o// //
